<title id="hero-title">A unipolar and five bipolar electrograms along a decapolar catheter</title>
<desc id="hero-desc">A planar wave travels from the distal pair CS12 to the proximal pair CS90. The distal unipolar channel shows a positive then negative deflection; each bipole shows a sharp deflection, 7 milliseconds after its neighbor, on a light grid like recording paper.</desc>
